name: Squad beat
summary: The group builds an 8-step beat out of friends' shouts and posts the loop to a story.
useWhen: friends keep quoting each other's catchphrases and want something silly for a story
a creative toy for a group story
dontUseWhen: a recap of real events (use semester-wrapped or trip-story)

params.rows: 1 to 4 rows: who (a name from the chat) and shout (their catchphrase, exactly as said in the chat)
params.grid: optional starting pattern per row, 8 characters of x and .
